name: Gemini 4 Argon
archDisplay: Proprietary model; architecture and parameter count undisclosed; 1M-token unified input-output limit
note: Google DeepMind's Sep 30, 2026 frontier model, announced by Koray Kavukcuoglu and first rolled out only to trusted cyber defenders via the Fairwind Program. On Oct 13, 2026 Google made it generally available on the paid tier of the Gemini API (AI Studio and the Gemini platform), in Antigravity for AI Ultra subscribers, and in the Gemini app for AI Pro/Ultra. Introductory price is $2/$10 per Mtok (cached input 95% off) until Nov 30, 2026, then $4/$20; Vals AI already bills its runs at the $4/$20 list price. Google reports DeepSWE v1.1 77.9%, AutomationBench 51.3% (#1), LVBench 91.7% and a tie for first on CWE-bench v1 at 68.0%. Vals AI's independent runs put it #1 on the Vals Index (68.90) and Finance Agent v2 (65.40), #6 on Terminal-Bench 4.0 (57.58) and #5 on Terminal-Bench Science (44.29). It trails competitors in Google's own table on FrontierSWE v2, Terminal-Bench 4.0, PostTrainBench, Terminal-Bench Science and OSWorld 2.0. Corpus choices: ctxK is filed as 1000 from Google's 1M unified input-output token limit; the headline price is the introductory $2/$10.
